WITH p AS (SELECT id FROM players WHERE uid=?1),
s AS (SELECT * FROM player_identity_segments WHERE player_id IN(SELECT id FROM p) OR id=?2 OR uid_snapshot=?1),
m AS (SELECT * FROM player_identity_tournaments WHERE player_id IN(SELECT id FROM p) OR segment_id=?2),
state AS (SELECT
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM p)=1
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tournaments a,tournaments b WHERE a.id=?3 AND b.id=?4 AND a.is_test=0 AND b.is_test=0 AND a.start_date<b.start_date)
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tournament_rosters r WHERE r.player_id IN(SELECT id FROM p) AND r.tournament_id=?3 AND r.team_id=?6 AND r.ign_snapshot=?5) AS valid,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s)=0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m)=0 AS empty,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s)=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m)=1
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s WHERE id=?2 AND player_id IN(SELECT id FROM p) AND uid_snapshot=?1 AND boundary_tournament_id=?4 AND ign_snapshot=?5 AND team_id=?6)
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM m WHERE player_id IN(SELECT id FROM p) AND tournament_id=?3 AND segment_id=?2) AS exact)
INSERT INTO player_identity_segments(id,player_id,uid_snapshot,boundary_tournament_id,ign_snapshot,team_id)
SELECT CASE WHEN valid AND empty THEN ?2 ELSE NULL END,(SELECT id FROM p),?1,?4,?5,?6
FROM state WHERE NOT(valid AND exact)

INSERT INTO player_identity_tournaments(player_id,tournament_id,segment_id)
SELECT p.id,?2,?3 FROM players p WHERE p.uid=?1
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM player_identity_tournaments m WHERE m.player_id=p.id AND m.tournament_id=?2 AND m.segment_id=?3)
